test_title: PYST 64: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase to replace the underlined word.

She is feeling __unwell__ today, so she will not be going to work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Under the weather**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Under the weather"** is an idiom that means feeling unwell or sick. (अस्वस्थ)

 
 
• **Example:** After staying out in the rain for too long, he started feeling under the weather.
 
 
 
• The word **"Feeling unwell"** in the sentence also implies the person is not in good health. Its Hindi meaning is (अच्छा महसूस नहीं करना).
 
 
• **Example:** She is feeling unwell and has decided to take a rest day at home.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **"Under the weather"** is the most appropriate replacement for "feeling unwell" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Under the weather**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Head in the clouds** (सपनों में खोया हुआ): Refers to someone who is daydreaming or not paying attention to reality.

 
 
• **Example:** He always has his head in the clouds during meetings and misses important details.
 
 
 
• **Face like thunder** (बहुत नाराज चेहरा): Refers to someone looking extremely angry or upset.
 
 
• **Example:** When she saw the mess in the kitchen, she had a face like thunder.
 
 
 
• **Chase rainbows** (असंभव चीजों का पीछा करना): Refers to pursuing unrealistic or impractical goals.
 
 
• **Example:** He is always chasing rainbows, dreaming of becoming a millionaire without putting in the effort.
 
 

33:T638,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
